subject.title: [Bug]: Matrix message read/pins CLI output renders completely blank tables

question: Should Matrix readMessages return deduplicated edited-message payloads to JSON/tool consumers, or should m.replace collapse stay display-only while preserving raw timeline-style payloads?
rationale: The blank table is a clear bug, but the active comprehensive fix also changes the Matrix read payload contract for all consumers, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept Comprehensive Matrix Fix
options.body: Use the open Matrix-local PR as the canonical path if Matrix reads should expose final edited messages consistently across CLI, JSON, and tool consumers.

options.title: Keep Dedup Display-Only
options.body: Require the fix to add formatter-friendly read/pins projection while keeping raw readMessages payloads closer to the Matrix timeline.

options.title: Split Blank Tables From Dedup
options.body: Land the read/pins projection first and track edited-message aggregation as a narrower follow-up with explicit payload-contract review.

recommendation.title: Accept Comprehensive Matrix Fix
recommendation.body: Use the open Matrix-local PR as the canonical path if Matrix reads should expose final edited messages consistently across CLI, JSON, and tool consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest Matrix plugin/action-boundary history and is the best available owner for the payload-contract choice.
